description: Any agent that speaks the Agent Client Protocol in Arkestra rooms: Gemini CLI, goose, OpenCode, the Claude and Codex adapters and more.
agents: Agents started in ACP mode. Each one can be invited into any room. `machine` is a connection from Arkestra · Connections; without it the agent runs on this machine. `env` applies on this machine only. Add one from the ACP Registry with **Arkestra: Add an ACP agent**.
agent.id: Stable id: letters, digits and hyphens.
agent.name: Name shown in the rooms.
agent.machine: Connection id of the SSH machine it runs on. Empty: this machine.
